print_errors.note: The phrase is fully vowelled, but the final mim of «وَعَظِيم» has no kasra. I checked this at 1400 dpi: there is a kasra under the za and nothing under the mim. Kept as printed, with no kasra added.
The first waw has no fatha (checked at 2000 dpi). Every other conjunction waw in this dua has one (وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ، وَبسيدنا). Kept as printed.

notes: Markers: p.072 ends with a complete sentence («[البقرة: ٢٨٤-٢٨٦].») and has no footnotes. p.073 starts with a new basmala + al-Kafirun, so it is <<<ص:073>>>. p.073 ends inside al-Nas, after «ٱلْخَنَّاسِ». p.074 continues the surah and opens with the ayah-4 end ornament «(٤)», so it is <<<ص:074+>>>. Because validate.py needs ﴿﴾ balanced on each line, the al-Nas quotation is closed with ﴾ at the end of p.073 and reopened with ﴿ at the start of p.074; neither bracket is printed at the page break (same handling as b18 p.071/072). The ayah-end number (٤), printed at the top of p.074, is kept there: «﴿(٤) ٱلَّذِى…». p.075 and p.076 each start with a new parenthesised dua, so they have no '+'. p.076 ends mid-dua with «…إِلَّا أَنْتَ،» and the parenthesis open; it continues on p.077. No footnotes, headings or poetry on these pages. Quran: scripts/quran.py reports no flags for the whole batch. Encoding follows CONVENTIONS §3 / Tanzil: rectangular zero on أَنَا۠ (109:4; an upright oval, checked at 1000 dpi); round silent zero on فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ (106:3; checked at 2600 dpi); iqlab high mim on تَوَّابًۢا and أَحَدٌۢ; low mim under the kasratan of خَوْفٍۭ; small yeh in إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ; madda on ٱلَّذِىٓ (106:4); small waw on إِنَّهُۥ، لَّهُۥ، يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ, but not on «لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ» (not printed there). Waqf signs are written where printed: ۚ after وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ (110:3); 59:22-24 ۖ ۖ ۚ ۖ ۚ ۖ. Each surah basmala is printed before the bracket and written outside it. References: Arabic-Indic digits in logical order (١-٦ etc.). Spacing was measured at 1000 dpi. The colon-to-digit gap is about 76-85 px, so a space is written after every colon ([الكافرون: ١-٦], [الحشر: ٢٢-٢٤] …). The gap between «]» and «(ثلاثًا)» on p.073/074 is about 55 px (twice the bracket side bearing), so a space is written: «[الإخلاص: ١-٤] (ثلاثًا).» This differs from b17 p.068, where the gap was about 27 px and no space was written. A space is always written between ﴾ and [. «(ثلاثًا)» has fathatan only, except «(ثَلاثًا)» with fatha on the first tha after al-Falaq (p.073) and on p.075 (2nd dua); each instance was checked. Reading notes «[تقرأ مرة واحدة للمتعجل]»: on p.074, 1st dua, the period and «[» are set tight («).[تقرأ», gap about 16 px against about 65 px elsewhere), so no space is written there; all the others have «). [تقرأ». Lam-alif: in this body font the left diagonal stroke is the alif and the right upright is the lam. This was checked against the hamza position in الأَرْضِ / الْأَذَى and the madda in الْآخِرَةِ, all at 2400 dpi. The fatha is over the alif stroke in «لاَ إِلَهَ» (p.074, last dua), «لاَ يَضُرُّ» and «وَلاَ فِي» (p.075), and those are written لاَ. Everywhere else it is over the lam stroke: لَا, and إِلَّا with shadda+fatha on the lam. «الأَرْضِ» (p.075) has hamza+fatha on the alif and a sukun on the ra, but no sukun on the lam (2400 dpi); «وَالْآخِرَةِ» (p.075), «وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ» (p.075) and «الْأَذَى» (p.076) do have the sukun on the lam. Allah: plain الله wherever only the ligature's own shadda/small alif are drawn (بِالله ×2, سُبْحَانَ الله ×3, بِسْمِ الله). On p.075 «بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ» has a kasra printed low under the ha of the Allah ligature (2200 dpi), so it is written اللَّهِ, as in b18 p.071. «اللَّهُمَّ» is always explicitly vowelled. Final ى drawn with the Lotus automatic small alif is written plain: عَلَى (p.074, p.076 ×2), أَمْسَى (p.075), الْأَذَى (p.076). In Quran, ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ keeps its dagger alif. Bold: on p.075 «مُحَمَّدٍ» is set in a clearly heavier face than «وَبسيدنا» and «نَبِيًّا» around it, so it is **مُحَمَّدٍ**, followed by the ﷺ glyph. «وَبسيدنا» has only the fatha on the waw. The «(ثلاثًا)» and «[تقرأ…]» notes and the duas are in the regular face, so no bold. Other details checked at high zoom: «مِن نِّعْمَةٍ» (p.075) has no sukun on the nun of مِن and shadda+kasra on the nun of نِّعْمَةٍ, as printed. The fatha on the final kaf (بِكَ، لَكَ، نِعْمَتَكَ، بِنِعْمَتِكَ، سُبْحَانَكَ …) is printed high on the kaf's ascender and was confirmed on each. «[أَمْسَيْتُ]» / «[أَمْسَى]» keep their square brackets. Running heads, page numbers, bracket flowers and ayah ornaments are omitted, except for the digits inside them.
